# dsm_user_home_service (Data Source)

Read-only data source exposing the state of the DSM user home service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_user_home_service" "homes" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the user home service is enabled.
- `enable_domain` (Boolean) Whether home folders are enabled for domain users.
- `enable_ldap` (Boolean) Whether home folders are enabled for LDAP users.
- `enable_recycle_bin` (Boolean) Whether the recycle bin is enabled on the `homes` shared folder.
- `encryption` (Number) Encryption mode reported by DSM for the `homes` shared folder (`0` means unencrypted).
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of this singleton data source (`user_home_service`).
- `location` (String) Volume path hosting the `homes` shared folder, e.g. `/volume1`. Empty if the service was never enabled.
- `personal_photo_enable` (Boolean) Whether personal Synology Photos space is enabled. Requires the Synology Photos package.
